phase: Phase 1A — freeze the canonical fail-closed stop conditions. Design-only.
principle: Fail-closed: on any stop condition, STOP — do not guess, infer, substitute, or proceed. Record the stop with evidence, owner, next action, and review point.

canonical_stops.wrong_dealer: Any artifact/row not bound to Serra Honda dealer 21043.
canonical_stops.service_parts_in_sales: Any Service/Parts evidence (visible rows OR hidden Lead Intent) in a Sales source/metric — whole-delivery quarantine.
canonical_stops.schema_drift: Header/type/field signature differs from the contracted schema_revision.
canonical_stops.protected_content_or_pii_outside_envelop: Message content / PII used without the authorized protected-content envelope.
canonical_stops.incompatible_baseline: Grade target/comparison definition, population, period, or denominator incompatible.
canonical_stops.source_substitution_or_skip: A required source is skipped or substituted by another.
canonical_stops.dirty_or_competing_writer: A dirty/competing writer overlaps the working branch/artifact.
canonical_stops.production_or_customer_behavior_change: Any action that would alter production or customer behavior (schedule, recipient, send, deploy).

blast_radius_rule.one_source_failure_blocks: only the dependent metric IDs of that source
blast_radius_rule.module_rule: a failed/blocked ID never erases the rest of its module; a rejected ID blocks only FINAL completion until corrected or converted to an evidence-backed allowed disposition

vault_policy_nonconformance_admission_ga.rule: New protected raw admission FAILS CLOSED until vault dirs are 0700 / files 0600 (or a documented dedicated service identity). Current runtime is NONCONFORMING (0750/0775/0755; files 0444).
vault_policy_nonconformance_admission_ga.enforced_by: packet admission_contract must mechanically inherit this gate; a packet cannot admit new protected raw while nonconforming.
vault_policy_nonconformance_admission_ga.status: PINNED / ENFORCEMENT NONCONFORMING -> Phase 3 fail-closed admission gate

inheritance_rule: A packet's stop_conditions.inherited_canonical MUST equal canonical_stop_names EXACTLY (mechanical inheritance, not any string), and its admission_contract MUST inherit inherited_admission_gates.vault_policy_nonconformance_admission_gate.
